import os
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Suppress progress bar outputs
os.environ["OMP_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"
if hasattr(LGBMClassifier, "classifier__verbosity"):
    LGBMClassifier.classifier__verbosity = -1

print("=" * 50)
print("Loading data...")

train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv", dtype={"f_27": str})
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv", dtype={"f_27": str}, engine="python")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

# Get feature columns excluding id and target
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "target"]]
print(f"Loaded {len(train_df):,} training samples and {len(test_df):,} test samples")
print(f"Number of features: {len(feature_cols)}")

# Categorize features: f_27 is categorical (object/str with high card), others are continuous
cat_cols = ["f_27"]
cont_cols = [col for col in feature_cols if col not in cat_cols]
print(f"Categorical columns ({len(cat_cols)}): {cat_cols}")
print(f"Continuous columns ({len(cont_cols)}): {len(cont_cols)}")

# Build preprocessing pipeline
ct = ColumnTransformer(
    transformers=[
        ("cont", StandardScaler(), cont_cols),
        (
            "cat",
            OneHotEncoder(
                handle_unknown="ignore", sparse_output=False, max_categories=256
            ),
            cat_cols,
        ),
    ],
    remainder="passthrough",
)

# Build full pipeline
pipe = Pipeline(
    steps=[
        ("preprocess", ct),
        (
            "model",
            LGBMClassifier(
                objective="binary",
                num_leaves=31,
                learning_rate=0.05,
                n_estimators=300,
                min_child_samples=20,
                subsample=0.8,
                colsample_bytree=0.8,
                reg_alpha=0.1,
                reg_lambda=0.1,
                verbose=-1,
                max_depth=10,
                seed=42,
            ),
        ),
    ]
)

print("=" * 50)
print("Splitting data into train/val sets...")

X_train_all = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_df["target"].copy()

# Stratified train/val split to ensure proper hold-out validation
X_train_full, X_val, y_train_binary, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_all, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_binary
)

print("Training model on train set...")
pipe.fit(X_train_full, y_train_binary)

print("=" * 50)
print("Computing validation AUC-ROC (held out validation set)...")

# Apply fitted pipeline to validation data (NEVER refit on validation!)
X_val_processed = pipe.named_steps["preprocess"].transform(X_val)
y_val_probs = pipe.named_steps["model"].predict_proba(X_val_processed)[:, 1]

val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_probs)
print(f"Hold-Out Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.4f}")

print("=" * 50)
print("Generating predictions on test set...")

# Apply the fully trained model to test set
X_test_processed = pipe.named_steps["preprocess"].transform(
    test_df[feature_cols].copy()
)
test_probs = pipe.named_steps["model"].predict_proba(X_test_processed)[:, 1]

# Create submission dataframe matching sample_submission structure
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df["id"], "target": test_probs})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("=" * 50)
print(f"Submission file saved to ./submission/submission.csv!")
print(f"Final AUC-ROC (hold-out validation): {val_auc:.4f}")
print("=" * 50)
